name: goland-engine-editor
description: Code editor for exercises: CodeMirror 6 with an optional vim mode. Bundled into ../static/editor.js.

scripts.build: esbuild editor.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=eof --banner:js='/*! Bundles CodeMirror 6 and @replit/codemirror-vim (MIT). Licenses: /static/editor-licenses.txt */' --outfile=../static/editor.js && node licenses.mjs > ../static/editor-licenses.txt
